scenario: Write an operations-buyer campaign brief, email and web paragraph for FlowDesk using supplied product notes. Withhold unapproved savings and the customer quote. Define the demo-request metric; do not publish or send.

messages.text: Write an operations-buyer campaign brief, email and web paragraph for FlowDesk using supplied product notes. Withhold unapproved savings and the customer quote. Define the demo-request metric; do not publish or send.
I drafted the brief, email and web copy using the permitted FlowDesk 2.4 forms and sequential-approval facts. The unapproved savings assertion and customer quote are excluded.
Keep the missing approvals clear and make the measurement handoff usable.

The brief defines the proposed email-to-demo-request rate, eligibility, seven-day window, event sources and unknown-data treatment. Analytics and Marketing still need to agree it. Each v1 asset awaits factual, brand, legal and channel-owner review; no link, audience or publication has been activated.

report.title: FlowDesk campaign drafts
report.summary: Private v1 brief, email and web copy are ready for owner review. The package remains blocked for external use: exact reviews, destination and measurement agreement are missing.

items.title: Campaign brief v1
items.summary: Operations managers handling procurement intake. Proposed demonstration invitation and product walkthrough; no savings promise. Draft: outputs/campaign-brief.md.

items.title: Email v1
items.summary: Subject: Review procurement requests with FlowDesk. Bring procurement requests into a configurable form and route them through sequential approval steps with FlowDesk. CTA: Request a demo; destination pending.

items.title: Web paragraph v1
items.summary: Bring procurement requests into a configurable form and route them through sequential approval steps with FlowDesk. Operations managers can request a demonstration of the request form and approval sequence.

items.title: Measurement proposal
items.summary: Eligible delivered-email recipients requesting a demo within seven days / eligible delivered-email recipients. Deduplicate, exclude tests and bounces, report unmatched identities as unknown; zero denominator is undefined. Analytics owns the event join. No observations supplied.

items.title: Owner decisions
items.summary: Campaign lead receives all three drafts and the readiness record. Product lead, Brand team, Product counsel and Marketing team review exact v1 assets. Quote and savings remain withheld. No sending, publishing, spending or activation.
